Your West Warwick project

Look closely at patches, worn areas, and old floor edges.

For a West Warwick refinishing project, show us more than the most scratched area. Dark marks, missing boards, old patches, and spots that feel loose can affect the work. We review the condition of the whole area before treating refinishing as the answer.

If carpet covers part of the floor, visible wood at a doorway only tells part of the story. Hidden areas may be different or need repairs. We can discuss an estimate based on accessible information and identify what needs checking once the surface can be seen.

Before your walkthrough

  • Photograph patches, stains, missing boards, and loose areas.
  • Tell us where wood is still covered by carpet or another material.
  • Include connected rooms when discussing the finish.

Answers before you start

West Warwick flooring questions.

Have a question about your own rooms? Ask for a callback.

Can you assess hardwood hidden under carpet?

We can discuss what is visible and what remains unknown. A small exposed area does not establish the condition of the whole room. The scope may need to be confirmed when the covering is removed and the boards can be inspected.

Will sanding remove every dark mark in my wood floor?

Not necessarily. Marks can extend deeper than the layer that can safely be sanded. We assess the floor and discuss whether refinishing, a board repair, or another approach is suitable, without promising that every mark will disappear.

Can damaged boards be repaired before refinishing?

We can assess damaged areas and discuss repairs as part of the scope. Board dimensions, material availability, and the surrounding floor affect the result. Repaired sections may retain some difference in grain or color.

Do you install new flooring in West Warwick as well?

Yes. We offer hardwood and LVP installation as well as refinishing. If the existing floor is unsuitable for another sanding or you want a different material, we can discuss removal, preparation, and a new installation.

Is the in-home estimate in West Warwick free?

Yes. We offer a free in-home estimate. After reviewing the space and your project, we provide a written, itemized scope so you can see what is included before work begins.

How do I request a callback?

Use the form on this page with your name, phone number, town, and project type. You can include a preferred call time. We will contact you about the project and confirm next steps; the requested time is a preference, not a booked appointment. You can also call (401) 602-0958.
